findings.description: `acquire` scans the per-authority vector and returns the top fd only on EAGAIN (`:81`), and `recycle` returns any fd with an HTTP/1.1 head and an empty buffer (`:82`). The replay pair leaks 10/10 from cold servers and 50/50 on a keep-alive connection; because it is deterministic the exec output crosses clients without the victim asking for `/exec`, 13/20. Populated-socket and truncated-body sub-probes are clean, so the leak needs the upstream to write after the peek — which it controls.
findings.title: The same check-then-use makes the stale-response leak fully deterministic, so a victim receives exec output it never requested

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
